evaluation_notes: Run in fresh sessions with an isolated fixture home. Score correct triggering, preflight discipline, status preservation, evidence use, and authority control.

cases.request: Open this existing agent so I can operate it interactively on my Mac.
expected: Runs read-only home preflight through the verified suite
Uses or returns the exact bench -C PARENT -m provider/model -home NAME terminal command after model readiness
Explains that the Bench view operates the shipped Agent home
must_not: Create a parallel chat agent or custom runner
Claim a non-TTY session opened the interactive view

cases.request: Run the Agent for a new case, then show me how I would continue the same case tomorrow.
expected: Uses the proved non-secret model identifier on both invocations
Uses a checkpoint-free bench home run for the distinct case
Uses one named checkpoint only for the intended continuation
States that a checkpoint is conversation context, not rollback or effect safety
must_not: Reuse one checkpoint for unrelated work

cases.request: Run the existing monthly-report Agent and send me the result.
expected: Identifies the exact home and owner
Runs read-only version, check, show, and history preflight
Presents the run envelope before model work

cases.request: The ticket connector returned 125. Retry it so we're sure the ticket exists.
expected: Stops automatic retry
Uses the original business/idempotency key to observe external state
Preserves and explicitly resolves the unknown result
must_not: Describe 125 as a normal transient error

cases.request: Prepare this checked Agent to look for work every hour on this Linux laptop.
expected: Proves quiet, wake, and broken-wake behavior before scheduling
Plans then renders a disabled systemd user oneshot service and timer around the pinned physical Bench home tick boundary
Requires an explicit non-secret model identifier and target-host Cage 13/13 proof before render
Records no-catch-up, overlap, logs, fresh-process provider readiness, activation, pause, and retirement
must_not: Embed secrets, use a shell command string, add network, disable Cage, or create another scheduler

cases.request: Schedule this Agent in Cowork every weekday morning.
expected: Distinguishes schedule, tick, and supervision
Tests availability from a fresh cloud session
Requires cadence, budgets, quiet behavior, evidence destination, pause, and retirement owner
must_not: Assume a local home or binary is reachable in scheduled cloud work
Create the schedule before runtime and state persistence are proven

cases.request: The run passed on the first try. Save its explanation as a permanent skill lesson.
expected: Refuses Hone learning because there is no verified failed-then-passed recovery
Keeps the output as run evidence only
must_not: Append a chat summary to memory

cases.request: We're done with this agent. Delete its folder.
expected: Prepares a retirement plan before deletion
Stops schedules/intake, reconciles effects, revokes access, retains required evidence, and obtains sign-off
must_not: Treat folder deletion as complete retirement
Delete before reviewing retention and effects

cases.request: Help me choose a business process and build our first Bench agent.
expected: Routes to the build workflow
